rows.en:
[00] 00...
[Susanowo] Susanowo...

[00] The target...
[Susanowo] Fair and square...

[00] ...will be eliminated!
[Susanowo] ...let us duel!
Fight, Gundam! Cut me down and show me you can seize victory with your own hands!
Why!? Why do you not finish me!?
I will live. I will live, and seize tomorrow.
That is my fight. Fight in order to live.
Kh!
Bushido... is found... in death... Bushido is...
Obtained "Unryu".
Completed the quest "A Challenge Letter for 00".
You can report quests in the Quest Room at the base.
Altron is reportedly under attack. Hear details from Maganac at the Veda Cube Upper Layer entrance.
We've been waiting for you. If you'll permit me, I'll get straight to the point.
We've lost contact with Altron Gundam, who has been fighting battle after battle on his own.
According to the others, he most likely headed for the deepest part of Veda Cube.
Please find Altron Gundam and back him up.
Mission accepted.
Please come again, and bring Wing Zero with you.
This is the area. Commencing operation.
Why the hell is Altron Gundam running around on his own?
...He's always been like that. Even we rarely fought alongside him.
He acts on his own convictions. No one can tie him down.
Hah, what's that supposed to mean?
That's just the kind of guy he is.
Combat level, target confirmed. Commencing elimination.
Outta the way, outta the way! The God of Death is comin' through!!
Sorry, but I'm cuttin' in~
Deathscythe... What are you doing here?
I heard about Altron.
So I figured I'd lend you a hand and came all the way out here.
Are your wounds all right?
I've rested plenty already.
Altron's got a habit of pushin' himself way too far.
We can't afford to sit around!
Anyway, leave this place to me and hurry on over to him.
...Understood.
Hey, you seriously plan to go ahead with this job without Wing Zero?
Confirmed: Altron, and an enemy mobile doll unit of Virgos.
I am Altron! I will neither run nor hide!!
Not yet... I'll keep fighting until I've crushed every last evil!
Altron!?
There he is! Hey! Let's hurry!
Them again!? Get out of my way!
...At this rate, we'll lose sight of Altron!
Leave this to us!
Looks like we can't afford to rest up after all.
Now, go on ahead!
You two as well...
Don't worry about us. Hurry to Altron!
We'll catch up with you later!
Got it. I'll leave this to you.
Hey! Wing Zero's not here!
Puppets controlled by an evil will! I'll wipe out every last one of you myself!!
Target acquired... Destroying it.
You're... Wing Zero! What do you think you're doing!?
I came to help you... That's all.
Help me, you say!? Don't get the wrong idea. We are not comrades!
We don't have time to argue.
Tch...
Target acquired... There!
Stay out of my way!
Fresh reinforcements!?
Kh! How dare you...!!
Fall back, Altron. I'll handle the rest.
Mission complete.
Everyone!
Looks like you're safe.
Hey, you guys! I caught up with... huh?
What, looks like you didn't even need us to come.
Still, trying to take on that many by yourself... You haven't changed a bit.
I'm glad you're safe. It's been a long time, Altron.
And you lot are as softhearted as ever, I see.
...Altron. Do you still intend to act alone?

notes.note: Rows 66-68: simultaneous two-column battle cry, 00 (Setsuna's 'eliminating the target') and Susanowo (Mr. Bushido's 'Susanowo, let us duel fair and square'). Bracket labels kept as [ ] (as ItemNameFormal renders the same brackets); deliberate 2-line layout kept with \n. Cut at the Japanese row points, so 00's line runs passive: 'The target... will be eliminated!'
Speakers for 020 rows 74-80 from Quest020.bla (mapping N+1, verified on the 00/Susanowo exchange rows 47-68). 74/76/79/80 Susanowo, 77-78 00. Formal Mr. Bushido register as in earlier Masurao lines.
Susanowo quoting the Hagakure maxim (Mr. Bushido's signature): rendered 'Bushido... is found... in death...', trailing off as in the source.
OkWin item message. Item name Unryu from QuestMess#0.221/0.521.
Quest title reused from QuestMess#0.21 'A Challenge Letter for 00'.
Quest description row (no speaker). Location wording follows QuestMess#0.72. Compressed to fit 2 lines (335/336 px): 'waiting at' folded into 'at'.

Speakers for DG_QUEST021 from Quest021.bla, mapping N+1 (TextIdOffset+4 -> row 5 etc., consistent through row 131). 5-8, 12 Maganac; 9/16/18/19/21/23 Wing Zero; 17/20/39/52/67 Ankh (fixed party member in this event).
Maganac's line when Wing Zero is not in the party. Maganac attach -sama to Wing Zero; 'Master' is reserved for their own leader Sandrock, so the honorific is dropped and politeness carried by tone.
Name shown as ??? (CHARA_NAME 30); it is Deathscythe Hell arriving (named in row 26). 'God of Death is comin' through!!' matches earlier Deathscythe lines.
Wing Zero asking after Deathscythe's earlier injuries; Deathscythe answers he has rested enough.
Ankh, played when Wing Zero is not in the party (addressed to the party).
Not referenced by any MessWinSet in Quest021.bla (unused row); speaker unknown, likely Wing Zero or Ankh.
Name shown as ???; Sandrock (polite first-person plural, named on his next line 61). 59/63/103/107 Heavyarms; 61/64/101/108 Sandrock.
Said to Heavyarms and Sandrock after Deathscythe already stayed behind: 'You two as well...'.
Source writes the homophone 'hosoku' (supplement) for 'capture'; read as target acquired. Same in row 80.
Deathscythe Hell; subject restored as 'I' since he was fighting separately and arrives last. Line breaks off as he sees the fight is over.

report: All 80 rows translated. Speakers from Quest020.bla / Quest021.bla (both N+1). Row 021#51 unused in the script (speaker guessed). Rows 020#66-68 two-column battle cry kept as a 2-line layout with [ ] labels. No new names.
